title: Should We Attend More or Less? Modulating Attention for Fairness
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates and addresses social bias related to religious groups. Using the BOLD dataset, the authors measure and mitigate toxicity in language model generations across subgroups including Christianity, Islam, Judaism, Buddhism, Sikhism, Atheism, and Hinduism, as detailed in the experimental results and visualized in Figures 8 and 9.
